name: trait TrustedRandomAccess : TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce
rule: If Self implements ExactSizeIterator, implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must ensure that self.len() always produces results consistent with self.size().
expression: Not expressible in the supplied DSL: it cannot test whether Self implements ExactSizeIterator, observe self.len() or self.size(), or quantify over their results across time.
